+      fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 and ${WHISPER_CPP_REF} is unavailable in the source checkout"
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$offline_commit" >/dev/null
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule update --init --recursive --no-fetch
+    printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO" "$WHISPER_CPP_REF" "$offline_commit" >"${source_state}.tmp"
+    mv -f -- "${source_state}.tmp" "$source_state"
+    return 0
+  fi
+
+  if [ ! -d "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/.git" ]; then
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" init --quiet
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
+  elif git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote set-url origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
+  else
+    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
+  fi
+
+  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" fetch --force --depth=1 --no-tags origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REF"
+  source_commit=$(git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" rev-parse --verify FETCH_HEAD)
+  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$source_commit" >/dev/null
+  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule sync --recursive
+  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule update --init --recursive --depth=1
+  [ -f "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/CMakeLists.txt" ] ||
+    fatal "fetched source does not contain CMakeLists.txt"
+  printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO" "$WHISPER_CPP_REF" "$source_commit" >"${source_state}.tmp"
+  mv -f -- "${source_state}.tmp" "$source_state"
+  chmod 0644 "$source_state"
+  info "prepared pinned source commit ${source_commit}"
+}
+
+detect_cuda_archs() {
+  cuda_archs=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap --format=csv,noheader 2>/dev/null |
+    awk -F. '
+      /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ {
+        value=$1 $2
+        if (!seen[value]++) values[++count]=value
+      }
+      END {
+        for (index = 1; index <= count; index++) {
+          printf "%s%s", values[index], index == count ? "" : ";"
+        }
+      }')
+  [ -n "$cuda_archs" ] || return 1
+  printf '%s\n' "$cuda_archs"
+}
+
+detect_amdgpu_targets() {
+  amdgpu_targets=$(rocminfo 2>/dev/null |
+    awk '
+      match($0, /gfx[0-9a-zA-Z]+/) {
+        value=substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)
+        if (!seen[value]++) values[++count]=value
+      }
+      END {
+        for (index = 1; index <= count; index++) {
+          printf "%s%s", values[index], index == count ? "" : ","
+        }
+      }')
+  [ -n "$amdgpu_targets" ] || return 1
+  printf '%s\n' "$amdgpu_targets"
+}
+
+build_whisper_cli() {
+  ensure_managed_dir "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR" .installer-whisper-build "build directory"
+  ensure_managed_dir "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR" .installer-whisper-output "output directory"
+  ensure_source_checkout
+
+  [ -x "$(command -v cmake)" ] || fatal "cmake is unavailable"
+  [ -x "$(command -v ninja)" ] || fatal "ninja is unavailable"
+  [ -x "$(command -v cc)" ] || fatal "C compiler is unavailable"
+  [ -x "$(command -v c++)" ] || fatal "C++ compiler is unavailable"
+
+  release_c_flags="-O3 -DNDEBUG"
+  release_cxx_flags="-O3 -DNDEBUG"
+  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_FAST_MATH" = 1 ]; then
+    release_c_flags="${release_c_flags} -ffast-math -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math"
+    release_cxx_flags="${release_cxx_flags} -ffast-math -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math"
+  fi
+  [ -z "$WHISPER_EXTRA_C_FLAGS" ] || release_c_flags="${release_c_flags} ${WHISPER_EXTRA_C_FLAGS}"
+  [ -z "$WHISPER_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS" ] || release_cxx_flags="${release_cxx_flags} ${WHISPER_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS}"
+
+  cc_path=$(command -v cc)
+  cxx_path=$(command -v c++)
+  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL" = 1 ]; then
+    cc_path=$(command -v icx 2>/dev/null || true)
+    cxx_path=$(command -v icpx 2>/dev/null || true)
+    [ -n "$cc_path" ] && [ -n "$cxx_path" ] ||
+      fatal "SYCL requires icx and icpx"
+  fi
+
+  set -- \
+    cmake \
+    -S "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" \
+    -B "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR" \
+    -G Ninja \
+    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
+    "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$cc_path" \
+    "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$cxx_path" \
+    "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_FLAGS" \
+    "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=$WHISPER_CXX_FLAGS" \
+    "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE=$release_c_flags" \
+    "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE=$release_cxx_flags" \
+    -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON \
+    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
+    -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
+    -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON \
+    -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF \
+    -DWHISPER_FATAL_WARNINGS=OFF \
+    -DWHISPER_CURL=OFF \
+    -DWHISPER_SDL2=OFF \
+    "-DWHISPER_COMMON_FFMPEG=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_FFMPEG")" \
+    "-DWHISPER_OPENVINO=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_OPENVINO")" \
+    "-DGGML_NATIVE=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_GGML_NATIVE")" \
+    "-DGGML_LTO=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_LTO")" \
+    "-DGGML_CCACHE=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CCACHE")" \
+    "-DGGML_OPENMP=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_OPENMP")" \
+    "-DGGML_CPU_REPACK=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CPU_REPACK")" \
+    -DGGML_CPU=ON \
+    -DGGML_STATIC=OFF \
+    -DGGML_BACKEND_DL=OFF \
+    -DGGML_RPC=OFF \
+    -DGGML_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
+    -DGGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
+    "-DGGML_BLAS=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_BLAS")" \
+    "-DGGML_BLAS_VENDOR=$WHISPER_BLAS_VENDOR" \
+    "-DGGML_CUDA=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA")" \
+    "-DGGML_CUDA_FA=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA_FA")" \
+    "-DGGML_CUDA_FORCE_MMQ=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_CUDA_FORCE_MMQ")" \
+    "-DGGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS")" \
+    "-DGGML_HIP=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_HIP")" \
+    "-DGGML_VULKAN=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_VULKAN")" \
+    "-DGGML_SYCL=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL")" \
+    "-DGGML_SYCL_F16=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL_F16")" \
+    "-DGGML_SYCL_TARGET=$WHISPER_SYCL_TARGET"
+
+  if [ "$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER" = sccache ]; then
+    [ -x "$(command -v sccache)" ] || fatal "sccache is unavailable"
+    install -d -m 0755 "$WHISPER_SCCACHE_DIR"
+    SCCACHE_DIR=$WHISPER_SCCACHE_DIR
+    export SCCACHE_DIR
+    set -- "$@" \
+      "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER" \
+      "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=$WHISPER_CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER"
+  fi
+
+  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA" = 1 ]; then
+    cuda_archs=$WHISPER_CUDA_ARCHS
+    if [ "$cuda_archs" = auto ]; then
+      cuda_archs=$(detect_cuda_archs) ||
+        fatal "could not detect CUDA architectures; set WHISPER_CUDA_ARCHS explicitly"
+    fi
+    set -- "$@" "-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=$cuda_archs"
+  fi
+  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_HIP" = 1 ]; then
+    amdgpu_targets=$WHISPER_AMDGPU_TARGETS
+    if [ "$amdgpu_targets" = auto ]; then
+      amdgpu_targets=$(detect_amdgpu_targets) ||
+        fatal "could not detect AMD GPU targets; set WHISPER_AMDGPU_TARGETS explicitly"
+    fi
+    set -- "$@" "-DAMDGPU_TARGETS=$amdgpu_targets"
+  fi
+  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL" = 1 ] && [ -n "$WHISPER_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH" ]; then
+    set -- "$@" "-DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=$WHISPER_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH"
+  fi
+  if [ -n "$WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS" ]; then
+    set -f
+    old_ifs=$IFS
+    IFS=' '
+    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+    for extra_cmake_arg in $WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS; do
+      case "$extra_cmake_arg" in
+        -*) set -- "$@" "$extra_cmake_arg" ;;
+        *) fatal "WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS entries must begin with a dash" ;;
+      esac
+    done
+    IFS=$old_ifs
+    set +f
+  fi
+
+  info "configuring pinned whisper.cpp source"
+  "$@"
+
+  build_jobs=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || printf 1)
+  case "$build_jobs" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) build_jobs=1 ;; esac
+  info "building whisper-cli with ${build_jobs} parallel jobs"
+  cmake --build "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR" --target whisper-cli --parallel "$build_jobs" --config Release
+
+  built_binary=
+  for candidate in \
+    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/bin/whisper-cli" \
+    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/bin/Release/whisper-cli" \
+    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/Release/whisper-cli"
+  do
+    if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
+      built_binary=$candidate
+      break
+    fi
+  done
+  [ -n "$built_binary" ] ||
+    fatal "cmake completed without producing whisper-cli"
+
+  install -d -m 0755 "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin" "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/metadata"
+  tmp_binary="${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/bin/.whisper-cli.tmp.$$"
+  install -m 0755 "$built_binary" "$tmp_binary"
+  if [ "$WHISPER_STRIP_BINARY" = 1 ] && command -v strip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    strip --strip-unneeded "$tmp_binary" 2>/dev/null ||
+      warn "strip could not process whisper-cli; keeping symbols"
+  fi
+  mv -f -- "$tmp_binary" "${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/bin/whisper-cli"
+  ln -sfn bin/whisper-cli "${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/whisper-cli"
+  printf 'managed by installer addon/whisper\n' >"${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/.installer-whisper-output"
+  chmod 0644 "${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/.installer-whisper-output"
+
+  case "$(readlink /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli 2>/dev/null || true)" in
+    ''|"$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin/whisper-cli") ;;
+    *) fatal "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli is an unmanaged symlink" ;;
+  esac
+  if [ -e /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli ] && [ ! -L /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli ]; then
+    fatal "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli exists and is not a managed symlink"
+  fi
+  ln -sfn "${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/bin/whisper-cli" /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli
+  [ -x /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli ] ||
+    fatal "stable whisper-cli symlink is not executable"
+}
+
+verify_model_file() {
+  model_path=$1
+  model_bytes=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$model_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
+  case "$model_bytes" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) return 1 ;; esac
+  minimum_bytes=$((model_mib * 1024 * 1024 * 70 / 100))
+  maximum_bytes=$((model_mib * 1024 * 1024 * 140 / 100))
+  [ "$model_bytes" -ge "$minimum_bytes" ] && [ "$model_bytes" -le "$maximum_bytes" ] ||
+    return 1
+  if head -c 512 "$model_path" 2>/dev/null |
+       grep -aEiq '<!doctype|<html|access denied|not found|unauthorized|forbidden'
+  then
+    return 1
+  fi
+  model_magic=$(od -An -N4 -tx1 "$model_path" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')
+  case "$model_magic" in
+    6c6d6767|67676d6c) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  if [ -n "$model_sha256" ]; then
+    [ "$(sha256sum "$model_path" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$model_sha256" ] ||
+      return 1
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+validate_model_resources() {
+  available_kib=$(df -Pk "$WHISPER_MODEL_DIR" | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }')
+  required_kib=$((model_mib * 1024 + model_mib * 128))
+  case "$available_kib" in
+    [0-9]*) ;;
+    *) fatal "could not determine free space for model directory" ;;
+  esac
+  [ "$available_kib" -ge "$required_kib" ] ||
+    fatal "insufficient free space for ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL}"
+
+  available_mem_mib=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ { print int($2 / 1024); exit }' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || true)
+  required_mem_mib=$((model_min_ram_gib * 1024))
+  case "$available_mem_mib" in
+    [0-9]*)
+      if [ "$available_mem_mib" -lt "$required_mem_mib" ]; then
+        if [ "$WHISPER_STRICT_RESOURCES" = 1 ]; then
+          fatal "${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL} requires at least ${model_min_ram_gib} GiB available RAM"
+        fi
+        warn "${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL} may require more RAM than currently available"
+      fi
+      ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+download_model() {
+  ensure_managed_dir "$WHISPER_MODEL_DIR" .installer-whisper-models "model directory"
+  model_path="${WHISPER_MODEL_DIR}/${model_file}"
+  if [ "$WHISPER_FORCE_DOWNLOAD" = 0 ] && [ -f "$model_path" ] && verify_model_file "$model_path"; then
+    info "reusing validated ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL} model"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  [ "$WHISPER_OFFLINE" = 0 ] ||
+    fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 and no valid ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL} model is available"
+
+  validate_model_resources
+  model_tmp="${model_path}.tmp.$$"
+  rm -f -- "$model_tmp"
+  if [ -n "$WHISPER_HF_TOKEN" ]; then
+    auth_config=$(mktemp /tmp/whisper-curl.XXXXXX)
+    chmod 0600 "$auth_config"
+    printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$WHISPER_HF_TOKEN" >"$auth_config"
+  fi
+  unset WHISPER_HF_TOKEN
+
+  info "downloading ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL}"
+  if [ -n "$auth_config" ]; then
+    curl \
+      --config "$auth_config" \
+      --connect-timeout 20 \
+      --fail \
+      --location \
+      --retry 6 \
+      --retry-all-errors \
+      --retry-delay 3 \
+      --show-error \
+      --output "$model_tmp" \
+      "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL"
+  else
+    curl \
+      --connect-timeout 20 \
+      --fail \
+      --location \
+      --retry 6 \
+      --retry-all-errors \
+      --retry-delay 3 \
+      --show-error \
+      --output "$model_tmp" \
+      "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL"
+  fi
+  rm -f -- "$auth_config"
+  auth_config=
+
+  if ! verify_model_file "$model_tmp"; then
+    rm -f -- "$model_tmp"
+    fatal "downloaded ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL} model failed validation"
+  fi
+  install -m 0644 "$model_tmp" "${model_path}.publish.$$"
+  mv -f -- "${model_path}.publish.$$" "$model_path"
+  rm -f -- "$model_tmp"
+  printf 'model=%s\nurl=%s\n' "$WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL" "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL" >"${model_path}.metadata"
+  chmod 0644 "${model_path}.metadata"
+}
+
+write_runtime_config() {
+  case "$WHISPER_RUNTIME_THREADS" in
+    auto|[1-9][0-9]*) ;;
+    *) fatal "runtime thread policy became invalid" ;;
+  esac
+  install -d -m 0755 /etc/whisper
+  runtime_tmp=/etc/whisper/whisper.conf.tmp.$$
+  {
+    printf '# Generated by installer addon/whisper. No credentials are stored here.\n'
+    printf "WHISPER_CLI='%s'\n" /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli
+    printf "WHISPER_MODEL='%s'\n" "${WHISPER_MODEL_DIR}/${model_file}"
+    printf "WHISPER_THREADS='%s'\n" "$WHISPER_RUNTIME_THREADS"
+  } >"$runtime_tmp"
+  chmod 0644 "$runtime_tmp"
+  mv -f -- "$runtime_tmp" /etc/whisper/whisper.conf
+  grep -Fq WHISPER_HF_TOKEN /etc/whisper/whisper.conf &&
+    fatal "runtime configuration must not contain a Hugging Face token"
+}
+
+build_whisper_cli
+download_model
+write_runtime_config
+info "completed whisper-cli build and model installation"
*** End Patch

content.text:
## Objective
- **User-requested outcome:** Integrate `whisper.cpp` / `whisper-cli` as a class-gated Debian-preseed desktop addon, with:
  1. An `addon/whisper` class and package selection so source build, model download, installed binary, recording helper, and desktop controls occur only when `whisper` is selected.
  2. Complete `WHISPER_*` policy in all desktop F2FS/Btrfs base and override profiles:
     - F2FS profiles: `tiny.en-q8_0`
     - Btrfs profiles: `small.en-q8_0`
     - `override/btrfs-de-main.env`: `medium.en-q8_0`
  3. Labwc `Win+R` and `Ctrl+Alt+R` recording toggles plus Waybar right-click microphone recording through `pw-record`.
  4. A Perl wrapper that records 16 kHz mono signed-16-bit WAV files, transcribes them with `whisper-cli`, stores timestamped normalized JSON, retains at most 20 WAV/JSON artifacts, and appends valid todo.txt entries to Sleek’s `whisper.txt`.
  5. Initial creation/configuration of `$HOME/Syncthing/sleek` and Sleek’s user-data configuration so the `whisper.txt` task file is available on opening Sleek.

- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - Whisper build/install/download and runtime assets are gated by selected `addon/whisper`.
  - Non-Whisper desktop selections retain their existing Waybar `pulseaudio` module and `Win+R` Labwc reconfigure action.
  - Whisper selections render `custom/whisper-audio`, display a distinct recording state/icon, and support right-click plus both requested hotkeys.
  - WAV names are `YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS.wav`, created under `$HOME/Music/Whisper/audio/`, with `pw-record --rate=16000 --channels=1 --format=s16`.
  - JSON names match the WAV stem, are stored under `$HOME/Music/Whisper/transcribed/`, contain only normalized transcript text with no Whisper segment timestamps, and retain only the latest 20 artifacts.
  - Todo entries are valid todo.txt syntax, contain the recognized text, and appear in `$HOME/Syncthing/sleek/whisper.txt`.
  - Sleek’s enforced AppArmor policy permits its configured `~/Syncthing/sleek` task directory.

- **Scope boundaries / non-goals:**
  - Do **not** edit `/tmp/install-runtime/**`, `/target/**`, or any installed runtime output directly.
  - Do **not** add config/service-content checks to `d-i/forky/scripts/desktop/verify.sh`; the project override explicitly prohibits it.
  - Do **not** add tests under `t/`.
  - Do not use host `/etc`, installed packages, services, or package database as intended-installation truth.
  - Do not commit, push, deploy, change branches, or create external side effects.
  - Preserve unrelated changes, untracked `logs/`, and all pre-existing user state.

- **Consequential assumptions made:**
  - `whisper` was added to `DEBIAN_DEFAULT_CLASSES`, so default desktop installations select it; explicit class selections that omit `whisper` remain excluded from build/runtime behavior.
  - `pipewire-bin` is a selected-class dependency because it provides `pw-record`.
  - `sccache` is included because the required profile values select it as both C/C++ compiler launcher, even though `WHISPER_ENABLE_CCACHE=0`.
  - The installed runtime config should contain only the stable CLI path, selected model path, and runtime thread policy; `WHISPER_HF_TOKEN` must remain temporary and never persist in `/etc`.
  - Sleek’s task file should be `whisper.txt`, registered in Sleek’s `files` config array rather than replacing any broader task-management configuration.

## Authority and Context
- **Governing instructions read:**
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/AGENTS.md`
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/INDEX.md`
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/docs/style/shell-runtime.md`
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/docs/style/bash.md`
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/docs/style/sh.md`
  - `/data/codex/usr/home/docs/style/perl.md`
  - `/home/mcramer/Workspace/debian-preseed-di-new/AGENTS.override.md`

- **Workflow / skills selected:**
  - Router: `/data/codex/usr/home/index/core/overview.md`
  - Workflow: `/data/codex/usr/home/docs/workflows/debian-preseed.md`
  - Plan: `/data/codex/usr/home/plans/workflows/workflow-debian-preseed.md`
  - Skills read:
    - `system-infra:debian-preseed`
    - `desktop-wayland:labwc`
    - `desktop-wayland:waybar`
    - `codex-runtime:perl`

- **Repository and environment:**
  - Repository: `/home/mcramer/Workspace/debian-preseed-di-new`
  - Branch verified before edits: `mcr/main`
  - Worktree was clean before this work began.
  - No `gitlab/*` or `github/*` mirror branches were found in the earlier branch check.
  - Shell environment: Zsh. New shell helpers must explicitly declare and be valid for `/bin/sh`; the runtime wrapper must be valid Perl.
  - Workspace filesystem is write-restricted to the workspace root; all current changes are within that root.

- **Repository constraints that matter:**
  - `d-i/forky/` is the authoritative installer source.
  - `d-i/forky/classes/configs/*.cfg` is class metadata; `d-i/forky/classes/class-addon/*.cfg` is class-specific `pkgsel` package policy.
  - `d-i/forky/hosts/profiles/**` is authoritative desktop profile policy.
  - `d-i/forky/scripts/late/dispatch.sh` executes selected class `LateHelper` scripts **after** shared F2FS/Btrfs preparation and **before** the desktop role late hook.
  - `d-i/forky/hooks/role/desktop/target/**` contains source assets for installed target paths, with `target/` stripped from the target location.
  - The desktop role renders Labwc and Waybar templates later via `d-i/forky/scripts/desktop/components.sh`.

# Repository Override Guidelines

## Project Structure and Ownership

- Treat `d-i/forky/` as installer source. Start at `preseed.cfg`; keep static answers in `common.cfg` and `fragments/*.cfg`.
- Keep class metadata in `classes/install.conf` and `classes/configs/*.cfg`; implementations live under the `class-*` directories.
- Keep authoritative profile policy in `hosts/profiles/**` and shared defaults in `hosts/shared/*.env`.
- Keep stage logic separated under `scripts/{preseed,early,partman,late,firstboot,runtime}/`.
- Treat `hooks/{shared,hardware,role,services}/**/target/**` as tracked runtime-mirror sources. Strip the `target/` prefix for the installed path; for example, `hooks/shared/target/etc/zram-writeback.conf` installs as `/etc/zram-writeback.conf`. Files ending in `.tmpl` are authoritative templates and render to the corresponding path without `.tmpl`.
- Avoid tests under `t/` unless requested. Do not invent packaging or release surfaces for installer-only changes.
- You are NOT allowed to include verification of content in config files or services inside the verfiy.sh script! Tests must be adapted to code base and NOT vice versa!!

## Fresh-Install and Evidence Model

- Serve this read-only tree to remote hosts. Treat every run as a fresh installation into a new `/target`; create all managed files, accounts, packages, directories, and service links each time. Do not implement upgrades, migrations, or reliance on earlier target state.
- Never use the current development host—its `/etc`, installed packages, services, logs, caches, or command output—as source of truth. Tracked repository files define intended state.
- When repository evidence is insufficient for package or configuration facts, use web search only and prefer official Debian or upstream documentation. Do not query local `apt`, `dpkg`, or system files; record the external source used.

## Generated Files and Mirrors

- Never edit or commit installer runtime output under `/tmp/install-runtime/**`, including `state/plan.tsv`, `cache/classes.state.conf`, and `runtime.env`.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

target_root=${1:-/target}
[ -d "$target_root" ] || exit 0

qemu_fatal() {
  printf 'fatal: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

qemu_info() {
  printf '[late:qemu] %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

qemu_validate_abs_path() {
  case "${2:-}" in
    /*) ;;
    *) qemu_fatal "$1 must be an absolute path: ${2:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  case "$2" in
    /|*..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/@%:+,-]*)
      qemu_fatal "$1 contains unsupported path syntax: $2"
      ;;
  esac
}

qemu_stage_target_asset() {
  repo_path=$1
  target_path=$2
  mode=$3
  tmp_asset="${tmp_env_dir}/$(basename "$target_path").$$"
  target_host_path="${target_root}${target_path}"

  qemu_validate_abs_path "target path" "$target_path"
  bootstrap_fetch_seed_file "$seed_base" "$repo_path" "$tmp_asset" 0600 "qemu asset ${repo_path}"
  install -d -m 0755 "${target_root}$(dirname "$target_path")"
  install -m "$mode" "$tmp_asset" "$target_host_path"
  chmod "$mode" "$target_host_path"
  rm -f "$tmp_asset"
}

qemu_render_target_asset() {
  repo_path=$1
  target_path=$2
  mode=$3
  shift 3
  tmp_asset="${tmp_env_dir}/$(basename "$target_path").$$"
  tmp_rendered="${tmp_asset}.rendered"
  target_host_path="${target_root}${target_path}"

  qemu_validate_abs_path "target path" "$target_path"
  bootstrap_fetch_seed_file "$seed_base" "$repo_path" "$tmp_asset" 0600 "qemu template ${repo_path}"
  installer_apply_scalar_placeholders "$tmp_asset" "$tmp_rendered" "$@"
  if grep -Eq '__INSTALLER_[A-Z0-9_]+__' "$tmp_rendered"; then
    rm -f "$tmp_asset" "$tmp_rendered"
    qemu_fatal "qemu template rendered with unresolved placeholders: ${repo_path}"
  fi
  install -d -m 0755 "${target_root}$(dirname "$target_path")"
  install -m "$mode" "$tmp_rendered" "$target_host_path"
  chmod "$mode" "$target_host_path"
  rm -f "$tmp_asset" "$tmp_rendered"
}

qemu_require_target_asset() {
  target_path=$1
  mode=${2:-readable}
  target_asset_path="${target_root}${target_path}"

  qemu_validate_abs_path "target path" "$target_path"
  case "$mode" in
    executable)
      # Host-side `test -x` can false-fail when the installer mounts the target
      # filesystem with restrictive execution semantics. The real execution
      # checks happen later through target-side commands.
      [ -r "$target_asset_path" ] || qemu_fatal "missing staged executable target asset: ${target_path}"
      [ -f "$target_asset_path" ] || qemu_fatal "staged executable target asset is not a regular file: ${target_path}"
      ;;
    readable)
      [ -r "$target_asset_path" ] || qemu_fatal "missing staged target asset: ${target_path}"
      ;;
    *)
      qemu_fatal "unsupported qemu target asset check mode: ${mode}"
      ;;
  esac
}

target_passwd_ids() {
  awk -F: -v wanted_user="$1" '$1 == wanted_user { print $3 ":" $4; exit }' "${target_root}/etc/passwd" 2>/dev/null || true
}

runtime_env_path() {
  for candidate in /tmp/install-env/runtime.env /tmp/install-runtime/state/runtime.env; do
    [ -r "$candidate" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$candidate"
    return 0
  done
  return 1
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

target_root=${1:-/target}
[ -d "$target_root" ] || exit 0

ch341a_fatal() {
  printf 'fatal: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

ch341a_info() {
  printf '[late:ch341a] %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

target_passwd_ids() {
  awk -F: -v wanted_user="$1" '$1 == wanted_user { print $3 ":" $4; exit }' "${target_root}/etc/passwd" 2>/dev/null || true
}

ch341a_validate_abs_path() {
  case "${2:-}" in
    /*) ;;
    *) ch341a_fatal "$1 must be an absolute path: ${2:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  case "$2" in
    /|*..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/@%:+,-]*)
      ch341a_fatal "$1 contains unsupported path syntax: $2"
      ;;
  esac
}

ch341a_stage_target_asset() {
  repo_path=$1
  target_path=$2
  mode=$3
  tmp_asset="${tmp_env_dir}/$(basename "$target_path").$$"
  target_host_path="${target_root}${target_path}"

  ch341a_validate_abs_path "target path" "$target_path"
  bootstrap_fetch_seed_file "$seed_base" "$repo_path" "$tmp_asset" 0600 "ch341a asset ${repo_path}"
  install -d -m 0755 "${target_root}$(dirname "$target_path")"
  install -m "$mode" "$tmp_asset" "$target_host_path"
  chmod "$mode" "$target_host_path"
  rm -f "$tmp_asset"
}

ch341a_render_target_asset() {
  repo_path=$1
  target_path=$2
  mode=$3
  shift 3
  tmp_asset="${tmp_env_dir}/$(basename "$target_path").$$"
  tmp_rendered="${tmp_asset}.rendered"
  target_host_path="${target_root}${target_path}"

  ch341a_validate_abs_path "target path" "$target_path"
  bootstrap_fetch_seed_file "$seed_base" "$repo_path" "$tmp_asset" 0600 "ch341a template ${repo_path}"
  installer_apply_scalar_placeholders "$tmp_asset" "$tmp_rendered" "$@"
  installer_assert_no_unresolved_installer_placeholders "$tmp_rendered" "ch341a template ${repo_path}"
  install -d -m 0755 "${target_root}$(dirname "$target_path")"
  install -m "$mode" "$tmp_rendered" "$target_host_path"
  chmod "$mode" "$target_host_path"
  rm -f "$tmp_asset" "$tmp_rendered"
}

runtime_env_path() {
  for candidate in /tmp/install-env/runtime.env /tmp/install-runtime/state/runtime.env; do
    [ -r "$candidate" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$candidate"
    return 0
  done
  return 1
}

runtime_dir=${INSTALLER_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp/install-runtime}
bootstrap_lib=${INSTALLER_BOOTSTRAP_LIB:-${runtime_dir}/bootstrap/bootstrap.sh}
tmp_env_dir=${INSTALLER_LATE_TMP_ENV_DIR:-/tmp/install-env-late/ch341a}

[ -s "$bootstrap_lib" ] || ch341a_fatal "installer bootstrap library is unavailable: ${bootstrap_lib}"
# shellcheck disable=SC1090,SC1091
. "$bootstrap_lib"
bootstrap_source_common_lib "" || ch341a_fatal "failed to source installer common library"
seed_base=$(installer_current_seed_base 2>/dev/null || installer_seed_base "")
bootstrap_source_common_support_libs "$seed_base" "$tmp_env_dir" fetch hook target || {
  ch341a_fatal "failed to source installer late support libraries"
}
installer_ensure_context_loaded "$seed_base"

installer_selected_class_reference_is_selected addon/ch341a 2>/dev/null || exit 0

account_env=${INSTALLER_LATE_ACCOUNT_ENV:-/tmp/install-env-late/account.env}
host_env=${INSTALLER_LATE_HOST_ENV:-/tmp/install-env-late/host.env}
[ -r "$account_env" ] || installer_fetch_account_env "$seed_base" "$account_env" 0600
[ -r "$host_env" ] || installer_fetch_host_env "$seed_base" "$(installer_resolve_host_profile "")" "$host_env" 0600

# shellcheck disable=SC1090,SC1091
. "$account_env"
# shellcheck disable=SC1090,SC1091
. "$host_env"

if runtime_env=$(runtime_env_path); then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090,SC1091
  . "$runtime_env"
fi

: "${ACCOUNT_USERNAME:?ACCOUNT_USERNAME must be set before staging ch341a assets}"
: "${DIR_POOL_FIRMWARE:=/pool/firmware}"
ch341a_validate_abs_path "DIR_POOL_FIRMWARE" "$DIR_POOL_FIRMWARE"

run_in_target "create ch341a authorization group" /bin/sh -eu -c '
command -v getent >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v groupadd >/dev/null 2>&1
getent group usbadmin >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
  groupadd --system usbadmin
getent group usbadmin >/dev/null 2>&1
' sh

ch341a_stage_target_asset \
  "$(installer_repo_join_var DIR_HOOKS_ROLE_DESKTOP target/etc/udev/rules.d/61-ch341a-programmers.rules)" \
  /etc/udev/rules.d/61-ch341a-programmers.rules \
  0644

ch341a_render_target_asset \

ch341a_render_target_asset \

if [ -n "${ACCOUNT_HOME:-}" ]; then

  install -d -m 0700 "${target_root}${ACCOUNT_HOME}/.profile.d"
  install -m 0644 \
    "${target_root}/etc/skel/.profile.d/75-firmware-workspace.sh" \
    "${target_root}${ACCOUNT_HOME}/.profile.d/75-firmware-workspace.sh"
  account_ids=$(target_passwd_ids "$ACCOUNT_USERNAME")
  if [ -n "$account_ids" ]; then
    chown "$account_ids" "${target_root}${ACCOUNT_HOME}/.profile.d"
    chown "$account_ids" "${target_root}${ACCOUNT_HOME}/.profile.d/75-firmware-workspace.sh"
  fi
fi

run_in_target "verify ch341a addon package baseline" /bin/sh -eu -c '

command -v IMSProg >/dev/null 2>&1

test -f /etc/udev/rules.d/61-ch341a-programmers.rules
test -f /etc/tmpfiles.d/86-firmware-workspace.conf
test -f /etc/skel/.profile.d/75-firmware-workspace.sh
' sh

run_in_target "create firmware workspace roots" /bin/sh -eu -c '
systemd-tmpfiles --create /etc/tmpfiles.d/86-firmware-workspace.conf
test -d "$1"
test -d "$1/$2"
test -d "$1/$2/captures"

test -d "$1/$2/work"
' sh "$DIR_POOL_FIRMWARE" "$ACCOUNT_USERNAME"

run_in_target "grant programmer USB access to primary account" /bin/sh -eu -c '
account_user=$1
getent group usbadmin >/dev/null 2>&1
usermod -a -G usbadmin -- "$account_user"
' sh "$ACCOUNT_USERNAME"

ch341a_info "staged firmware workspace assets for account=${ACCOUNT_USERNAME}"

desktop_render_labwc_rc_xml() {
  workspace_count=${LABWC_WORKSPACE_COUNT:-4}
  rc_path=/etc/skel/.config/labwc/rc.xml

  desktop_render_role_target_template_deferred \
    "etc/skel/.config/labwc/rc.xml.tmpl" \
    "$rc_path" \
    0644 \
    LABWC_WORKSPACE_COUNT "$workspace_count" \
    LABWC_ICON_THEME "$(desktop_xml_attribute_escape "${LABWC_ICON_THEME:-Papirus-Dark}")" \
    LABWC_FILE_MANAGER_COMMAND "$(desktop_xml_attribute_escape "${LABWC_FILE_MANAGER_COMMAND:-thunar}")" \
    LABWC_AUDIO_CONTROL_COMMAND "$(desktop_xml_attribute_escape "${LABWC_AUDIO_CONTROL_COMMAND:-pavucontrol}")" \
    LABWC_KEYBOARD_REPEAT_RATE "${LABWC_KEYBOARD_REPEAT_RATE:-40}" \
    LABWC_KEYBOARD_REPEAT_DELAY "${LABWC_KEYBOARD_REPEAT_DELAY:-250}" \
    LABWC_FONT_WINDOW_SIZE "${LABWC_FONT_WINDOW_SIZE:-12}" \
    LABWC_FONT_MENU_SIZE "${LABWC_FONT_MENU_SIZE:-13}" \
    LABWC_FONT_OSD_SIZE "${LABWC_FONT_OSD_SIZE:-13}" \
    LABWC_MOUSE_POINTER_SPEED "${LABWC_MOUSE_POINTER_SPEED:-0.55}" \
    LABWC_MOUSE_ACCEL_PROFILE "${LABWC_MOUSE_ACCEL_PROFILE:-flat}"
  desktop_replace_block_placeholder_in_target \
    "$rc_path" \
    "__INSTALLER_LABWC_WORKSPACE_NAME_LINES__" \
    "$(desktop_labwc_workspace_name_lines)"
  desktop_replace_block_placeholder_in_target \
    "$rc_path" \
    "__INSTALLER_LABWC_WORKSPACE_KEYBIND_LINES__" \
    "$(desktop_labwc_workspace_keybind_lines)"
  desktop_assert_role_target_template_resolved "etc/skel/.config/labwc/rc.xml.tmpl" "$rc_path"
  desktop_log "rendered_labwc_rc_xml workspaces=${workspace_count}"
}

== target exec fallback ==
target_root_dir() {
  printf '%s\n' "${INSTALLER_TARGET_DIR:-/target}"
}

target_exec_available() {
  target_root=$(target_root_dir)

  case "$target_root" in
    /target|/target/)
      command -v in-target >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
      ;;
  esac

  command -v chroot >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d "$target_root" ]
}

target_exec() {
  target_root=$(target_root_dir)

  case "$target_root" in
    /target|/target/)
      if command -v in-target >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        (
          unset \
            DEBCONF_DB_REPLACE \
            DEBCONF_REDIR \
            DEBCONF_FRONTEND \
            DEBCONF_NONINTERACTIVE_SEEN \
            DEBCONF_SYSTEMRC \
            DEBCONF_PIPE \
            DEBCONF_USE_CDEBCONF \
            DEBCONF_DEBUG \
            DEBCONF_NOWARNINGS \
            DEBCONF_TERSE \
            DEBIAN_FRONTEND
          in-target --pass-stdout "$@"
        )
        return
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  if command -v chroot >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d "$target_root" ]; then
    chroot "$target_root" /usr/bin/env -i \
      PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
      "$@"
    return
  fi

  if command -v in-target >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    installer_fatal "in-target cannot execute non-default installer target root: ${target_root}"
  fi

  installer_fatal "neither chroot nor in-target is available for target command execution"
}

target_command_failure_state_path() {
  printf '%s/state/last-target-command.failure\n' "$(installer_runtime_dir)"
}

target_clear_command_failure_state() {
  target_failure_state_path=$(target_command_failure_state_path)
  rm -f "$target_failure_state_path"
}

target_record_command_failure() {
  target_failure_label=$1
  target_failure_status=$2
  target_failure_state_path=$(target_command_failure_state_path)
  target_failure_state_tmp="${target_failure_state_path}.tmp.$$"
  target_failure_state_dir=$(dirname "$target_failure_state_path")
  target_failure_label=$(printf '%s' "$target_failure_label" | tr '\r\n' '  ')

  case "$target_failure_status" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) target_failure_status=1 ;;
  esac

  install -d -m 0700 "$target_failure_state_dir"
  {
    printf 'status=%s\n' "$target_failure_status"
    printf 'label=%s\n' "$target_failure_label"
  } >"$target_failure_state_tmp"
  chmod 0600 "$target_failure_state_tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
  mv "$target_failure_state_tmp" "$target_failure_state_path"
}

print_command() {
  for arg in "$@"; do
    printf ' %s' "$arg"
  done
  printf '\n'
}

target_log_should_emit() {
  if command -v installer_log_should_emit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    installer_log_should_emit "$1"
== precise placeholder replacement ==
          installer_fatal "${var} must be a non-negative integer"
          ;;
      esac
      printf '%s=%s\n' "$var" "$value"
    done
  done
}

apply_placeholder_map_to_target() {
  target_path=$1
  map_func=$2
  rendered_tmp="${target_path}.map.$$"
  map_tmp="${TMP_ENV_DIR}/target-placeholder-map.$$.tmp"

  set --
  if ! "$map_func" >"$map_tmp"; then
    rm -f "$map_tmp"
    installer_fatal "failed to render placeholder map ${map_func} for ${target_path}"
  fi
  while IFS= read -r map_line || [ -n "$map_line" ]; do
    map_name=${map_line%%=*}
    map_value=${map_line#*=}
    [ -n "$map_name" ] || continue
    set -- "$@" "$map_name" "$map_value"
  done <"$map_tmp"
  rm -f "$map_tmp"
  installer_apply_scalar_placeholders "$target_path" "$rendered_tmp" "$@" || {
    rm -f "$map_tmp"
    rm -f "$rendered_tmp"
    installer_fatal "failed to apply placeholder map ${map_func} to ${target_path}"
  }
  mv "$rendered_tmp" "$target_path"
}

replace_placeholder_line_block() {
  target_path=$1
  placeholder=$2
  replacement=$3
  rendered_tmp="${target_path}.line.$$"

  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    if [ "$line" = "$placeholder" ]; then
      [ -n "$replacement" ] && printf '%s\n' "$replacement"
      continue
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$line"
  done <"$target_path" >"$rendered_tmp"
  mv "$rendered_tmp" "$target_path"
}

apply_sysctl_profile_placeholders() {
  target_path=$1
  apply_placeholder_map_to_target "$target_path" sysctl_profile_placeholder_map
}

set -Eeuo pipefail

resolve_path() {
    local path=$1 joined
    if [[ "$path" = /* ]]; then
        joined="$path"
    else
        joined="$ROOT_DIR/$path"
    fi
    if command -v realpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        realpath -m -- "$joined"
    else
        printf '%s\n' "$joined"
    fi
}

SOURCE_DIR_ABS="$(resolve_path "$SOURCE_DIR")"
BUILD_DIR_ABS="$(resolve_path "$BUILD_DIR")"
OUTPUT_DIR_ABS="$(resolve_path "$OUTPUT_DIR")"

require_cmd() {

}

validate_bool() {
    local name=$1 value=${!1:-}
    case "$value" in

        die "ENABLE_SYCL_F16=1 requires ENABLE_SYCL=1"
    fi

    local label path
    for label in SOURCE_DIR BUILD_DIR OUTPUT_DIR MODEL_DIR; do
        case "$label" in
            SOURCE_DIR) path="$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" ;;
            BUILD_DIR)  path="$BUILD_DIR_ABS" ;;
            OUTPUT_DIR) path="$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" ;;
            MODEL_DIR)  path="$MODEL_DIR_ABS" ;;
        esac
        [[ -n "$path" && "$path" != "/" && "$path" != "$ROOT_DIR" ]] \
            || die "$label resolves to an unsafe path: $path"
        if [[ "$ALLOW_EXTERNAL_DIRS" == "0" && "$path" != "$ROOT_DIR/"* ]]; then
            die "$label must remain under ROOT_DIR unless ALLOW_EXTERNAL_DIRS=1: $path"
        fi
    done

    # Source, build, and output trees must be independent. MODEL_DIR may be a
    # child of OUTPUT_DIR, which is the default and intentional layout.
    paths_overlap "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" "$BUILD_DIR_ABS" && die "SOURCE_DIR and BUILD_DIR must not overlap"
    paths_overlap "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" && die "SOURCE_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR must not overlap"
    paths_overlap "$BUILD_DIR_ABS" "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" && die "BUILD_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR must not overlap"
    paths_overlap "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" && die "SOURCE_DIR and MODEL_DIR must not overlap"
    paths_overlap "$BUILD_DIR_ABS" "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" && die "BUILD_DIR and MODEL_DIR must not overlap"
    if paths_overlap "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" \
        && [[ "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" != "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" && "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" != "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS/"* ]]; then
        die "When OUTPUT_DIR and MODEL_DIR overlap, MODEL_DIR must be OUTPUT_DIR itself or one of its children"
    fi
    if sccache_enabled; then
        paths_overlap "$SCCACHE_DIR_ABS" "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" && die "SCCACHE_DIR and SOURCE_DIR must not overlap"
        paths_overlap "$SCCACHE_DIR_ABS" "$BUILD_DIR_ABS" && die "SCCACHE_DIR and BUILD_DIR must not overlap"
        paths_overlap "$SCCACHE_DIR_ABS" "$OUTPUT_DIR_ABS" && die "SCCACHE_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR must not overlap"
        paths_overlap "$SCCACHE_DIR_ABS" "$MODEL_DIR_ABS" && die "SCCACHE_DIR and MODEL_DIR must not overlap"
    fi
    return 0
}

logical_cores() {
    if command -v nproc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        nproc
    else
        getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || printf '1\n'
    fi
}

physical_cores() {
    if command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        local count logical
        count="$(lscpu -p=CORE,SOCKET 2>/dev/null | awk -F, '!/^#/ {print $1 "," $2}' | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
        logical="$(logical_cores)"
        if [[ "$count" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( count > 0 )); then
            (( count > logical )) && count=$logical
            printf '%s\n' "$count"
            return
        fi
    fi
    logical_cores
}

build_jobs() {
    if [[ "$BUILD_JOBS" == "auto" || -z "$BUILD_JOBS" ]]; then
        logical_cores
    elif [[ "$BUILD_JOBS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$BUILD_JOBS"
    else
        die "BUILD_JOBS must be 'auto' or a positive integer"
    fi
}

selected_cxx() {
    if [[ -n "$CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER"
    elif [[ "$ENABLE_SYCL" == "1" ]] && command -v icpx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        command -v icpx
    else
        command -v c++ 2>/dev/null || printf 'c++\n'
    fi
}

selected_cc() {
    if [[ -n "$CMAKE_C_COMPILER" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$CMAKE_C_COMPILER"
    elif [[ "$ENABLE_SYCL" == "1" ]] && command -v icx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        command -v icx
    else
        command -v cc 2>/dev/null || printf 'cc\n'
    fi
}

native_flags() {
    local arch
    arch="$(uname -m)"
    case "$arch" in
        x86_64|amd64|i?86)
            printf '%s\n' '-march=native -mtune=native'
            ;;
        aarch64|arm64|armv7l|armv8l)
            printf '%s\n' '-mcpu=native'
            ;;
        ppc64|ppc64le)
            printf '%s\n' '-mcpu=native -mtune=native'
            ;;
        riscv64)
            printf '%s\n' '-march=native -mtune=native'
            ;;
        *)
            printf '\n'
            ;;
    esac
}

effective_native_flags() {
    if [[ "$GGML_NATIVE" == "1" ]]; then
        native_flags
    else
        printf '\n'
    fi
}

fast_math_flags() {
    if [[ "$ENABLE_FAST_MATH" == "1" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' '-ffast-math -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math'
    else
        printf '\n'
    fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
# shellcheck source=lib.sh
source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)/lib.sh"

validate_common_config
require_cmd git

stamp="$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.native-builder-source"
managed_marker="$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.native-builder-source-dir"
expected_key="$WHISPER_CPP_REPO|$WHISPER_CPP_REF"

ensure_clean_checkout() {
    local changes
    changes="$(git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
    [[ -z "$changes" ]] && return 0

    if [[ "$FORCE_SOURCE_RESET" == "1" ]]; then
        warn "Discarding tracked changes in managed source because FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1"
        git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" reset --hard HEAD
        git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" submodule foreach --recursive 'git reset --hard HEAD' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    else
        printf '%s\n' "$changes" >&2
        die "Managed source has tracked changes. Set FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1 to discard them."
    fi
}

read_stamp() {
    old_repo=''
    old_ref=''
    old_commit=''
    [[ -f "$stamp" ]] || return 1
    IFS='|' read -r old_repo old_ref old_commit <"$stamp" || return 1
    [[ -n "$old_repo" && -n "$old_ref" && -n "$old_commit" ]]
}

write_management_files() {
    local commit=$1
    printf 'native whisper.cpp source directory\nroot=%s\n' "$ROOT_DIR" >"$managed_marker"
    printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO" "$WHISPER_CPP_REF" "$commit" >"$stamp.tmp"
    mv -f "$stamp.tmp" "$stamp"
}

verify_source_tree() {
    [[ -f "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/CMakeLists.txt" ]] \
        || die "The selected source ref does not contain the expected top-level CMakeLists.txt"
}

if [[ -e "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" && ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" ]]; then
    die "SOURCE_DIR exists but is not a directory: $SOURCE_DIR_ABS"
fi
if [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" && ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.git" ]]; then
    first_entry="$(find "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -z "$first_entry" ]] || die "SOURCE_DIR exists but is not an empty directory or Git checkout: $SOURCE_DIR_ABS"
fi

if [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.git" && ! -f "$managed_marker" && ! -f "$stamp" ]]; then
    if [[ "$FORCE_SOURCE_RESET" == "1" ]]; then
        warn "Adopting an existing Git checkout as managed source because FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1"
        printf 'native whisper.cpp source directory\nroot=%s\n' "$ROOT_DIR" >"$managed_marker"
    else
        die "Refusing to modify an unmarked Git checkout in SOURCE_DIR. Use an empty path or set FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1 to adopt it."
    fi
fi

# Reuse the exact stamped commit without touching the network. This path still
# checks for tracked modifications and restores HEAD if it was moved manually.
if [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.git" && "$SOURCE_UPDATE" == "0" ]] && read_stamp; then
    if [[ "$old_repo|$old_ref" == "$expected_key" ]] \
        && git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" cat-file -e "${old_commit}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
        ensure_clean_checkout
        current_commit="$(git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
        if [[ "$current_commit" != "$old_commit" ]]; then
            git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$old_commit"
        fi
        verify_source_tree
        printf 'native whisper.cpp source directory\nroot=%s\n' "$ROOT_DIR" >"$managed_marker"
        info "Reusing whisper.cpp source at ${old_commit:0:12} ($WHISPER_CPP_REF)"
        exit 0
    fi
fi

if [[ "$OFFLINE" == "1" ]]; then
    [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.git" ]] || die "OFFLINE=1 but no managed source exists at $SOURCE_DIR_ABS"
    ensure_clean_checkout

    offline_commit=''
    if read_stamp && [[ "$old_repo|$old_ref" == "$expected_key" ]] \
        && git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" cat-file -e "${old_commit}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
        offline_commit="$old_commit"
    elif offline_commit="$(git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" rev-parse --verify "${WHISPER_CPP_REF}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
        :
    else
        die "OFFLINE=1 and ref '$WHISPER_CPP_REF' is not available in the local checkout"
    fi

    git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$offline_commit"
    git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" submodule update --init --recursive --no-fetch \
        || die "OFFLINE=1 but one or more required submodules are unavailable locally"
    verify_source_tree
    write_management_files "$offline_commit"
    info "Offline mode: source ready at ${offline_commit:0:12} ($WHISPER_CPP_REF)"
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS/.git" ]]; then
    log "Initializing managed whisper.cpp source checkout"
    mkdir -p "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS"
    printf 'native whisper.cpp source directory\nroot=%s\n' "$ROOT_DIR" >"$managed_marker"
    git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" init --quiet
    git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
else
    ensure_clean_checkout
    printf 'native whisper.cpp source directory\nroot=%s\n' "$ROOT_DIR" >"$managed_marker"
    if git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" remote set-url origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
    else
        git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
    fi
fi

log "Fetching source ref $WHISPER_CPP_REF"
git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" fetch --force --depth=1 --no-tags origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REF"
commit="$(git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" rev-parse --verify FETCH_HEAD)"
git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$commit"
git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" submodule sync --recursive
git -C "$SOURCE_DIR_ABS" submodule update --init --recursive --depth=1
verify_source_tree
write_management_files "$commit"
info "Source ready: ${commit:0:12} ($WHISPER_CPP_REF)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
ROOT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd -P)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

fake="$tmp/fake-upstream"
mkdir -p "$fake"
cat >"$fake/CMakeLists.txt" <<'CMAKE'
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(fake_whisper LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
add_executable(whisper-cli main.cpp)
CMAKE
cat >"$fake/main.cpp" <<'CPP'
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
int main(int argc, char ** argv) {
    if (argc > 1 && std::string(argv[1]) == "--version") {
        std::cout << "whisper.cpp fake-test 1.0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    std::cout << "fake whisper-cli\n";
    return 0;
}
CPP
printf 'MIT test license\n' >"$fake/LICENSE"
git -C "$fake" init -q
git -C "$fake" config user.email test@example.invalid
git -C "$fake" config user.name test
git -C "$fake" add .
git -C "$fake" commit -q -m initial
ref="$(git -C "$fake" rev-parse HEAD)"

common_env=(
    CONFIG_FROM_MAKE=1
    ROOT_DIR="$ROOT_DIR"
    WHISPER_CPP_REPO="$fake"
    WHISPER_CPP_REF="$ref"
    SOURCE_DIR="$tmp/source"
    BUILD_DIR="$tmp/build"
    OUTPUT_DIR="$tmp/output"
    MODEL_DIR="$tmp/output/models"
    CMAKE_GENERATOR=auto
    BUILD_JOBS=2
    CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=
    CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=
    CMAKE_C_FLAGS=
    CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=
    SCCACHE_DIR=
    GGML_NATIVE=1
    ENABLE_LTO=1
    ENABLE_CCACHE=0
    ENABLE_OPENMP=0
    ENABLE_CPU_REPACK=1
    ENABLE_FAST_MATH=0
    ENABLE_BLAS=0
    ENABLE_CUDA=0
    ENABLE_CUDA_FA=1
    CUDA_FORCE_MMQ=0
    CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=0
    ENABLE_HIP=0
    ENABLE_VULKAN=0
    ENABLE_SYCL=0
    ENABLE_SYCL_F16=0
    ENABLE_OPENVINO=0
    ENABLE_FFMPEG=0
    STRIP_BINARY=0
    OFFLINE=0
    SOURCE_UPDATE=0
    FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=0
    STRICT_RESOURCES=0
    FORCE_DOWNLOAD=0
    ALLOW_EXTERNAL_DIRS=1
)

run_wrapper() {
    env "${common_env[@]}" "$@"
}

run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/doctor.sh" >"$tmp/doctor.log" 2>&1
if grep -q -- 'CMAKE_GENERATOR was set' "$tmp/doctor.log"; then
    printf 'CMAKE_GENERATOR leaked into the CMake environment\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/source.sh" >/dev/null
[[ -f "$tmp/source/.native-builder-source" ]]
[[ -f "$tmp/source/.native-builder-source-dir" ]]

# Exact stamped source reuse and offline reuse must both work without fetching.
run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/source.sh" >/dev/null
run_wrapper OFFLINE=1 "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/source.sh" >/dev/null

# Tracked changes are protected unless the destructive reset is explicit.
printf '\n// dirty test\n' >>"$tmp/source/main.cpp"
if run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/source.sh" >"$tmp/dirty.log" 2>&1; then
    printf 'source protection test unexpectedly succeeded\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
grep -q 'tracked changes' "$tmp/dirty.log"
run_wrapper FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1 "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/source.sh" >/dev/null
if grep -q -- 'dirty test' "$tmp/source/main.cpp"; then
    printf 'FORCE_SOURCE_RESET did not remove the tracked source modification\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi

run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/configure.sh" >/dev/null
[[ -f "$tmp/build/.native-builder-build" ]]
run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/build.sh" >/dev/null
run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/verify.sh" >/dev/null
[[ -x "$tmp/output/bin/whisper-cli" ]]
[[ -f "$tmp/output/.native-builder-output" ]]
[[ -f "$tmp/output/metadata/build-info.txt" ]]
grep -q '^cxx_flags_release=-O3 -DNDEBUG ' "$tmp/output/metadata/build-info.txt"
grep -q '^binary_sha256=' "$tmp/output/metadata/build-info.txt"
"$tmp/output/bin/whisper-cli" --version | grep -q 'fake-test'

# Cleaning must preserve models; distclean additionally removes managed source.
mkdir -p "$tmp/output/models"
printf 'native whisper.cpp model directory\n' >"$tmp/output/models/.native-builder-models"
printf 'preserve me\n' >"$tmp/output/models/test-model.bin"
run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/clean.sh" build >/dev/null
[[ ! -e "$tmp/build" ]]
[[ ! -e "$tmp/output/bin/whisper-cli" ]]
[[ -d "$tmp/source/.git" ]]
[[ -f "$tmp/output/models/test-model.bin" ]]

run_wrapper "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/clean.sh" distclean >/dev/null
[[ ! -e "$tmp/source" ]]
[[ -f "$tmp/output/models/test-model.bin" ]]

run_wrapper CONFIRM=YES "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/clean.sh" purge >/dev/null
[[ ! -e "$tmp/output" ]]

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

fatal() {
  printf 'fatal: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

[ "${LABWC_SESSION_OWNER:-}" = desktop ] ||
  fatal "Wayscriber toggle requires the managed Labwc desktop session"
[ "${XDG_SESSION_TYPE:-}" = wayland ] ||
  fatal "Wayscriber toggle requires a Wayland session"

case "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-}" in
  /|*..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/-]*)
    fatal "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unavailable or invalid"
    ;;
  /*) ;;
  *) fatal "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unavailable or invalid" ;;
esac
case "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" in
  ''|*/*|*..*) fatal "WAYLAND_DISPLAY is unavailable or invalid" ;;
esac
[ -S "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/${WAYLAND_DISPLAY}" ] ||
  fatal "the active Wayland socket is unavailable"
[ -x /usr/bin/wayscriber ] ||
  fatal "the Wayscriber package executable is unavailable"

service=wayscriber.service
if ! /usr/bin/systemctl --user --quiet is-active "$service"; then
  /usr/bin/systemctl --user reset-failed "$service" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  /usr/bin/systemctl --user start "$service" ||
    fatal "unable to start the Wayscriber daemon"
fi

attempt=1
while [ "$attempt" -le 20 ]; do
  if /usr/bin/systemctl --user --quiet is-active "$service" &&
     /usr/bin/wayscriber --daemon-toggle; then
    exit 0
  fi

  if ! /usr/bin/systemctl --user --quiet is-active "$service"; then
    /usr/bin/systemctl --user reset-failed "$service" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    /usr/bin/systemctl --user start "$service" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  /usr/bin/sleep 0.1
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
done

+#!/bin/sh

+# Keep this helper POSIX-shell compatible because it executes inside the target

+}

+}
+
+require_command() {

+}
+

+  esac
+}
+
+validate_absolute_path() {

+      fatal "$label contains unsupported path syntax: $value"
+      ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+paths_overlap() {
+  first=${1%/}
+  second=${2%/}
+
+  [ "$first" = "$second" ] && return 0
+  case "$first" in
+    "$second"/*) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  case "$second" in
+    "$first"/*) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  return 1
+}
+
+validate_flag_value() {
+  label=$1
+  value=$2
+

+    *[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_./:=,+@% -]*)

+  esac
+}
+
+managed_marker_path() {

+}
+
+managed_dir() {
+  dir_path=$1
+  dir_label=$2
+  marker_path=$(managed_marker_path "$dir_path")
+
+  [ ! -L "$dir_path" ] ||
+    fatal "managed ${dir_label} directory must not be a symbolic link: $dir_path"
+  if [ -e "$dir_path" ] && [ ! -d "$dir_path" ]; then
+    fatal "managed ${dir_label} path exists but is not a directory: $dir_path"
+  fi

+  fi
+
+  if [ -e "$marker_path" ]; then
+    [ ! -L "$marker_path" ] && [ -f "$marker_path" ] ||
+      fatal "managed ${dir_label} marker is invalid: $marker_path"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# during installation.  The profile is staged as a root-owned temporary file by
# the selected addon helper; no build settings are inherited from the installer
# environment.

fatal() {
  printf 'fatal: whisper-install: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

info() {
  printf '[whisper-install] %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

require_command() {
  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    fatal "required command is unavailable: $1"
}

validate_bool() {
  case "$2" in
    0|1) ;;
    *) fatal "$1 must be 0 or 1" ;;
  esac
}

validate_pool_path() {
  label=$1
  value=$2

  case "$value" in
    /pool/*) ;;
    *) fatal "$label must remain below /pool: ${value:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  case "$value" in
    *..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/@%:+,-]*)

}

validate_absolute_path() {
  label=$1
  value=$2

  case "$value" in
    /*) ;;
    *) fatal "$label must be an absolute path: ${value:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  case "$value" in
    /|*..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/@%:+,-]*)
      fatal "$label contains unsupported path syntax: $value"
      ;;
  esac
}

paths_overlap() {
  first=${1%/}
  second=${2%/}

  [ "$first" = "$second" ] && return 0
  case "$first" in
    "$second"/*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  case "$second" in
    "$first"/*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1

validate_flag_value() {
  label=$1
  value=$2

    *[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_./:=,+@% -]*)

  [ -r "$state_path" ] || return 1

  IFS='|' read -r state_repo state_ref state_commit <"$state_path" || return 1
  [ "$state_repo" = "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO" ] || return 1
  [ "$state_ref" = "$WHISPER_CPP_REF" ] || return 1
  case "$state_commit" in
    ????????*) printf '%s\n' "$state_commit" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

write_source_state() {
  source_commit=$1
  state_path=$(source_state_path)
  state_tmp="${state_path}.tmp.$$"

  printf '%s|%s|%s\n' \
    "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO" \
    "$WHISPER_CPP_REF" \
    "$source_commit" >"$state_tmp"
  chmod 0600 "$state_tmp"
  mv -f "$state_tmp" "$state_path"
}

source_is_clean() {
  source_changes=$(git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
  [ -z "$source_changes" ]
}

restore_managed_source() {
  source_is_clean && return 0
  [ "$WHISPER_FORCE_SOURCE_RESET" = 1 ] ||
    fatal "managed source contains tracked changes; set WHISPER_FORCE_SOURCE_RESET=1 to discard them"

  info "restoring tracked changes in the managed source tree"
  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- .
  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" clean -ffdqx \
    -e .installer-whisper-managed \
    -e .installer-whisper-source
}

ensure_source_checkout() {
  source_state=
  if [ -d "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/.git" ]; then
    restore_managed_source
    source_state=$(source_state_commit 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$WHISPER_SOURCE_UPDATE" = 0 ] &&
       [ -n "$source_state" ] &&
       git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" cat-file -e "${source_state}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null
    then
      git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$source_state"
      [ -f "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/CMakeLists.txt" ] ||
        fatal "managed source checkout lacks CMakeLists.txt"
      info "reusing pinned whisper.cpp source ${source_state}"
      return 0
    fi
  fi

  if [ "$WHISPER_OFFLINE" = 1 ]; then
    [ -d "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/.git" ] ||
      fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 requires a managed source checkout"
    [ -n "$source_state" ] ||
      fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 requires a matching managed source state"
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" cat-file -e "${source_state}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null ||
      fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 cannot find the pinned source commit"
    restore_managed_source
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$source_state"
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule update --init --recursive --no-fetch ||
      fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 but required source submodules are unavailable"
    [ -f "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/CMakeLists.txt" ] ||
      fatal "managed source checkout lacks CMakeLists.txt"
    return 0
  fi

  require_command git
  if [ ! -d "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/.git" ]; then
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" init --quiet
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
  elif git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote set-url origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
  else
    git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" remote add origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REPO"
  fi

  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" fetch --force --depth=1 --no-tags origin "$WHISPER_CPP_REF"
  source_commit=$(git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" rev-parse --verify FETCH_HEAD)
  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --detach --force "$source_commit"
  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule sync --recursive
  git -C "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" submodule update --init --recursive --depth=1
  [ -f "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR/CMakeLists.txt" ] ||
    fatal "selected whisper.cpp source ref lacks CMakeLists.txt"
  write_source_state "$source_commit"
  info "prepared whisper.cpp source ${source_commit}"
}

available_cores() {
  if command -v nproc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nproc
  else
    getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || printf '1\n'
  fi
}

validate_resource_budget() {
  [ "$WHISPER_STRICT_RESOURCES" = 1 ] || return 0

  case "$WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL" in
    tiny.en-q8_0)
      minimum_memory_mib=1024
      minimum_cores=2
      ;;
    small.en-q8_0)
      minimum_memory_mib=3072
      minimum_cores=4
      ;;
    medium.en-q8_0)
      minimum_memory_mib=5120
      minimum_cores=6
      ;;
    *) fatal "internal model resource mapping is unavailable" ;;
  esac

  available_memory_kib=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ { print $2; exit }' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || true)
  case "$available_memory_kib" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) fatal "cannot determine available system memory for strict Whisper resources" ;;
  esac
  available_memory_mib=$((available_memory_kib / 1024))
  available_core_count=$(available_cores)
  case "$available_core_count" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) fatal "cannot determine available CPU cores for strict Whisper resources" ;;
  esac

  [ "$available_memory_mib" -ge "$minimum_memory_mib" ] ||
    fatal "strict resources require at least ${minimum_memory_mib} MiB for ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL}"
  [ "$available_core_count" -ge "$minimum_cores" ] ||
    fatal "strict resources require at least ${minimum_cores} CPU cores for ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL}"
}

model_spec() {
  case "$WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL" in
    tiny.en-q8_0)
      model_filename=ggml-tiny.en-q8_0.bin
      model_url=https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-tiny.en-q8_0.bin
      model_sha256=
      model_min_bytes=$((38 * 1024 * 1024))
      model_max_bytes=$((48 * 1024 * 1024))
      ;;
    small.en-q8_0)
      model_filename=ggml-small.en-q8_0.bin
      model_url=https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-small.en-q8_0.bin
      model_sha256=67a179f608ea6114bd3fdb9060e762b588a3fb3bd00c4387971be4d177958067
      model_min_bytes=0
      model_max_bytes=0
      ;;
    medium.en-q8_0)
      model_filename=ggml-medium.en-q8_0.bin
      model_url=https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-medium.en-q8_0.bin
      model_sha256=43fa2cd084de5a04399a896a9a7a786064e221365c01700cea4666005218f11c
      model_min_bytes=0
      model_max_bytes=0
      ;;
    *) fatal "unsupported WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL: ${WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  [ "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL" = "$model_url" ] ||
    fatal "WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL does not match WHISPER_DEFAULT_MODEL"
}

model_has_expected_magic() {
  candidate=$1
  [ -f "$candidate" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate" ] || return 1
  magic=$(LC_ALL=C dd if="$candidate" bs=4 count=1 2>/dev/null | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
  [ "$magic" = 67676d6c ]
}

model_is_valid() {
  candidate=$1

  model_has_expected_magic "$candidate" || return 1
  if [ -n "$model_sha256" ]; then
    actual_sha256=$(sha256sum "$candidate" | awk '{print $1}')
    [ "$actual_sha256" = "$model_sha256" ] || return 1
    return 0
  fi

  candidate_bytes=$(wc -c <"$candidate" | tr -d ' ')
  case "$candidate_bytes" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  [ "$candidate_bytes" -ge "$model_min_bytes" ] &&
    [ "$candidate_bytes" -le "$model_max_bytes" ]
}

download_model() {
  final_model=$1
  model_tmp="${WHISPER_MODEL_DIR}/.${model_filename}.tmp.$$"
  curl_config=

  require_command curl
  rm -f "$model_tmp"
  if [ -n "$WHISPER_HF_TOKEN" ]; then
    curl_config=$(mktemp /tmp/whisper-curl.XXXXXX)
    chmod 0600 "$curl_config"
    printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$WHISPER_HF_TOKEN" >"$curl_config"
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 \
      --config "$curl_config" \
      --output "$model_tmp" \
      "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL"
  else
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 \
      --output "$model_tmp" \
      "$WHISPER_DOWNLOAD_URL"
  fi

  model_is_valid "$model_tmp" ||
    fatal "downloaded model failed the expected integrity checks: ${model_filename}"
  chmod 0644 "$model_tmp"
  mv -f "$model_tmp" "$final_model"
  model_tmp=
}

prepare_model() {
  final_model="${WHISPER_MODEL_DIR}/${model_filename}"

  if [ "$WHISPER_FORCE_DOWNLOAD" = 0 ] && model_is_valid "$final_model"; then
    info "reusing verified model ${model_filename}"
    return 0
  fi
  [ "$WHISPER_OFFLINE" = 0 ] ||
    fatal "WHISPER_OFFLINE=1 cannot obtain a missing or invalid model: ${model_filename}"
  download_model "$final_model"
  info "downloaded verified model ${model_filename}"
}

append_extra_cmake_args() {
  [ -n "$WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS" ] || return 0
  saved_ifs=$IFS
  set -f
  IFS=' '
  # The value is validated to a limited option character set before this split.
  set -- "$@" $WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS
  IFS=$saved_ifs
  set +f
  printf '%s\n' "$@"
}

configure_and_build() {
  combined_c_flags=$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_FLAGS
  combined_cxx_flags=$WHISPER_CXX_FLAGS
  [ -z "$WHISPER_EXTRA_C_FLAGS" ] ||
    combined_c_flags="${combined_c_flags} ${WHISPER_EXTRA_C_FLAGS}"
  [ -z "$WHISPER_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS" ] ||
    combined_cxx_flags="${combined_cxx_flags} ${WHISPER_EXTRA_CXX_FLAGS}"

  upstream_ccache=$WHISPER_ENABLE_CCACHE
  if [ -n "$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER" ]; then
    upstream_ccache=0
  fi

  set -- \
    cmake \
    -S "$WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR" \
    -B "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR" \
    -G Ninja \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=${combined_c_flags}" \
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=${combined_cxx_flags}" \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_FATAL_WARNINGS=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_CURL=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_SDL2=OFF \
    "-DWHISPER_COMMON_FFMPEG=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_FFMPEG")" \
    "-DWHISPER_OPENVINO=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_OPENVINO")" \
    "-DGGML_NATIVE=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_GGML_NATIVE")" \
    "-DGGML_LTO=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_LTO")" \
    "-DGGML_CCACHE=$(cmake_bool "$upstream_ccache")" \
    "-DGGML_OPENMP=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_OPENMP")" \
    "-DGGML_CPU_REPACK=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CPU_REPACK")" \
    "-DGGML_CPU=ON" \
    "-DGGML_BLAS=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_BLAS")" \
    "-DGGML_BLAS_VENDOR=${WHISPER_BLAS_VENDOR}" \
    "-DGGML_CUDA=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA")" \
    "-DGGML_CUDA_FA=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA_FA")" \
    "-DGGML_CUDA_FORCE_MMQ=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_CUDA_FORCE_MMQ")" \
    "-DGGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS")" \
    "-DGGML_HIP=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_HIP")" \
    "-DGGML_VULKAN=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_VULKAN")" \
    "-DGGML_SYCL=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL")" \
    "-DGGML_SYCL_F16=$(cmake_bool "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL_F16")" \
    "-DGGML_SYCL_TARGET=${WHISPER_SYCL_TARGET}"

  if [ -n "$WHISPER_CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER" ]; then
    set -- "$@" \
      "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=${WHISPER_CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER}" \
      "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=${WHISPER_CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER}"
  fi
  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_CUDA" = 1 ] && [ "$WHISPER_CUDA_ARCHS" != auto ]; then
    set -- "$@" "-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=${WHISPER_CUDA_ARCHS}"
  fi
  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_HIP" = 1 ] && [ "$WHISPER_AMDGPU_TARGETS" != auto ]; then
    set -- "$@" "-DAMDGPU_TARGETS=${WHISPER_AMDGPU_TARGETS}"
  fi
  if [ "$WHISPER_ENABLE_SYCL" = 1 ] && [ -n "$WHISPER_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH" ]; then
    set -- "$@" "-DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=${WHISPER_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH}"
  fi

  if [ -n "$WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS" ]; then
    saved_ifs=$IFS
    set -f
    IFS=' '
    # The profile parser rejects wildcard and shell control characters.
    set -- "$@" $WHISPER_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS
    IFS=$saved_ifs
    set +f
  fi

  info "configuring whisper-cli"
  "$@"

  build_jobs=$(available_cores)
  case "$build_jobs" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*|0) build_jobs=1 ;;
  esac
  info "building whisper-cli with ${build_jobs} job(s)"
  cmake --build "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR" --target whisper-cli --parallel "$build_jobs"

  built_binary=
  for candidate in \
    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/bin/whisper-cli" \
    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/bin/Release/whisper-cli" \
    "$WHISPER_BUILD_DIR/Release/whisper-cli"
  do
    if [ -x "$candidate" ] && [ -f "$candidate" ]; then
      built_binary=$candidate
      break
    fi
  done
  [ -n "$built_binary" ] ||
    fatal "CMake completed but whisper-cli was not found in the build directory"

  install -d -m 0755 "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin"
  binary_tmp="${WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR}/bin/.whisper-cli.tmp.$$"
  rm -f "$binary_tmp"
  install -m 0755 "$built_binary" "$binary_tmp"
  if [ "$WHISPER_STRIP_BINARY" = 1 ]; then
    require_command strip
    strip --strip-unneeded "$binary_tmp"
  fi
  mv -f "$binary_tmp" "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin/whisper-cli"

  stable_binary=/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli
  if [ -e "$stable_binary" ] && [ ! -L "$stable_binary" ]; then
    fatal "refusing to replace unmanaged whisper-cli path: $stable_binary"
  fi
  if [ -L "$stable_binary" ]; then
    existing_link=$(readlink "$stable_binary")
    [ "$existing_link" = "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin/whisper-cli" ] ||
      fatal "refusing to replace unmanaged whisper-cli symlink: $stable_binary"
  fi
  install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/bin
  ln -sfn "$WHISPER_OUTPUT_DIR/bin/whisper-cli" "$stable_binary"
}

write_runtime_config() {
  runtime_conf_dir=/etc/whisper
  runtime_conf="${runtime_conf_dir}/whisper.conf"
  runtime_conf_tmp="${runtime_conf}.tmp.$$"

  [ ! -L "$runtime_conf_dir" ] ||
    fatal "runtime configuration directory must not be a symbolic link"
  if [ -e "$runtime_conf_dir" ] && [ ! -d "$runtime_conf_dir" ]; then
    fatal "runtime configuration path exists but is not a directory"
  fi
  install -d -m 0755 "$runtime_conf_dir"
  cat >"$runtime_conf_tmp" <<EOF
WHISPER_CLI=/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli
WHISPER_MODEL=${WHISPER_MODEL_DIR}/${model_filename}
WHISPER_RUNTIME_THREADS=${WHISPER_RUNTIME_THREADS}
EOF
  chmod 0644 "$runtime_conf_tmp"
  mv -f "$runtime_conf_tmp" "$runtime_conf"
}

config_path=${1:-/tmp/whisper-install.env}

model_tmp=

  exit 1
}

whisper_info() {

}

whisper_validate_abs_path() {
  label=$1
  value=$2

  case "$value" in
    /*) ;;
    *) whisper_fatal "$label must be an absolute path: ${value:-unset}" ;;
  esac
  case "$value" in
    /|*..*|*//*|*[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._/@%:+,-]*)
      whisper_fatal "$label contains unsupported path syntax: $value"
      ;;
  esac
}

whisper_validate_pool_path() {
  label=$1
  value=$2

  whisper_validate_abs_path "$label" "$value"
  case "$value" in
    /pool/*) ;;
    *) whisper_fatal "$label must remain under /pool: $value" ;;
  esac
}

whisper_validate_bool() {
  case "$2" in
    0|1) ;;

}

  label=$1

  invalid_chars=$(printf '%s' "$value" |

    whisper_fatal "$label contains unsupported characters"

whisper_paths_overlap() {
  first=${1%/}
  second=${2%/}

  [ "$first" = "$second" ] && return 0

installer_validate_class_manifest() {
  if [ "${INSTALLER_CLASS_MANIFEST_VALIDATED:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  installer_classes_cache_ensure
  installer_ensure_classes_conf_path
  conf_path=$INSTALLER_CLASSES_CONF_PATH_CACHE
  manifest_version=$(installer_ini_get "$conf_path" manifest version 2>/dev/null || true)
  seen_groups=' '
  seen_purposes=' '
  seen_classes=' '
  group_count=0

  case "$manifest_version" in
    '') ;;
    *[!0-9]*) installer_fatal "classes/install.conf ManifestVersion must be numeric: ${manifest_version}" ;;
  esac

  while IFS= read -r group_name || [ -n "$group_name" ]; do
    [ -n "$group_name" ] || continue
    installer_validate_class_group_name "class group name" "$group_name"
    case "$seen_groups" in
      *" ${group_name} "*) installer_fatal "duplicate group record in classes/configs/groups.cfg: ${group_name}" ;;
    esac
    seen_groups="${seen_groups}${group_name} "
    group_count=$((group_count + 1))

    required_value=$(installer_ini_get "$conf_path" "group.${group_name}" required 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$required_value" in
      ''|0|1|true|TRUE|false|FALSE|yes|YES|no|NO|on|ON|off|OFF|required|optional) ;;
      *) installer_fatal "group ${group_name} has invalid required value: ${required_value}" ;;
    esac

    multi_value=$(installer_ini_get "$conf_path" "group.${group_name}" multi 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$multi_value" in
      ''|0|1|true|TRUE|false|FALSE|yes|YES|no|NO|on|ON|off|OFF|single|multi) ;;
      *) installer_fatal "group ${group_name} has invalid multi value: ${multi_value}" ;;
    esac

    source_value=$(installer_ini_get "$conf_path" "group.${group_name}" source 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$source_value" in
      ''|class-auto|class-select|class-profile|class-addon|class-apps) ;;
      *) installer_fatal "group ${group_name} has invalid source value: ${source_value}" ;;
    esac

    order_value=$(installer_ini_get "$conf_path" "group.${group_name}" order 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$order_value" in
      '') ;;
      *[!0-9]*) installer_fatal "group ${group_name} has invalid order value: ${order_value}" ;;
    esac

    group_purpose=$(installer_group_purpose "$group_name")
    if [ -n "$group_purpose" ]; then
      installer_validate_class_purpose "group ${group_name} purpose" "$group_purpose"
      case "$seen_purposes" in
        *" ${group_purpose} "*)
          installer_fatal "duplicate group purpose in classes/configs/groups.cfg: ${group_purpose}"
          ;;
      esac
      seen_purposes="${seen_purposes}${group_purpose} "
    fi
  done <<EOF
$(installer_group_names)
EOF

  [ "$group_count" -gt 0 ] || installer_fatal "classes/configs/groups.cfg must define at least one group record"

  while IFS= read -r class_record || [ -n "$class_record" ]; do
    [ -n "$class_record" ] || continue
    case "$class_record" in
      *.*) ;;
      *) installer_fatal "configured class record must use group.class shape, got: ${class_record}" ;;
    esac
    record_group_name=${class_record%%.*}
    record_class_name=${class_record#*.}
    installer_validate_class_group_name "class metadata group" "$record_group_name"
    installer_validate_class_name "class metadata name" "$record_class_name"
    case "$seen_groups" in
      *" ${record_group_name} "*) ;;
      *) installer_fatal "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} references undefined class group ${record_group_name}" ;;
    esac
    case "$seen_classes" in
      *" ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} "*)
        installer_fatal "duplicate class record in classes/configs/*.cfg: ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name}"
        ;;
    esac
    seen_classes="${seen_classes}${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} "

    installer_validate_helper_name "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} early_helper" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" early_helper)"
    installer_validate_helper_name "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} partman_helper" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" partman_helper)"
    installer_validate_helper_name "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} late_helper" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" late_helper)"
    helper_order_value=$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" late_helper_order)
    case "$helper_order_value" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) [ -z "$helper_order_value" ] || installer_fatal "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} late_helper_order must be numeric: ${helper_order_value}" ;;
    esac
    installer_validate_class_reference_list "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} requires_classes" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" requires_classes)"
    installer_validate_class_reference_list "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} allowed_hardware_classes" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" allowed_hardware_classes)"
    installer_validate_class_reference_list "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} rejected_classes" \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" rejected_classes)"
    installer_normalize_apt_preferences_config \
      "$(installer_class_meta_value "" "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name" debian_apt_preferences)" \
      "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} debian_apt_preferences" >/dev/null

    class_relpath=$(installer_class_source_path "$record_group_name" "$record_class_name")
    if [ -n "${INSTALLER_SOURCE_ROOT:-}" ] && [ ! -r "${INSTALLER_SOURCE_ROOT%/}/${class_relpath}" ]; then
      installer_fatal "class ${record_group_name}/${record_class_name} metadata references missing fragment: ${class_relpath}"
    fi
  done <<EOF
$(installer_configured_class_records)
EOF
  INSTALLER_CLASS_MANIFEST_VALIDATED=1
}
